WITH race_avg_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    r.raceId,
    c.country,
    AVG(ds.wins) as race_avg_wins
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
),
country_avg_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(race_avg_wins) as country_avg
  FROM race_avg_wins
  GROUP BY country
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM country_avg_wins
),
above_overall_cte AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    c.country_avg,
    oa.overall_avg
  FROM country_avg_wins c
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE c.country_avg > oa.overall_avg
),
above_group_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg) as above_group_avg
  FROM above_overall_cte
)
SELECT 
  ao.country,
  ao.country_avg,
  ao.country_avg - ao.overall_avg as above_overall,
  ao.country_avg - ag.above_group_avg as above_group
FROM above_overall_cte ao
CROSS JOIN above_group_cte ag
WHERE ao.country_avg > ag.above_group_avg
ORDER BY ao.country_avg DESC;

assumptions.assumption: "drivers' wins in the standings" refers to driverStandings.wins (a season-to-date running count per the VERIFIED section), not wins recorded in individual races (results table)
We include all drivers appearing in driverStandings for each race; averaging over these records at the race level gives equal weight to each race regardless of number of drivers competing
Races with NULL circuit country are excluded from analysis

alternatives.interpretation: "drivers' wins" could mean the count of drivers who finished 1st (position='1') in each race. Then average those win counts per race, then average per country.
alternatives.sql:
WITH race_winners AS (
  SELECT 
    r.raceId,
    c.country,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN res.position = '1' THEN 1 END) as race_win_count
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  LEFT JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId AND res.position = '1'
  WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
),
country_avg_winners AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(race_win_count) as country_avg
  FROM race_winners
  GROUP BY country
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM country_avg_winners
),
above_overall_cte AS (
  SELECT c.country, c.country_avg, oa.overall_avg
  FROM country_avg_winners c
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE c.country_avg > oa.overall_avg
),
above_group_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg) as above_group_avg FROM above_overall_cte
)
SELECT 
  ao.country, ao.country_avg,
  ao.country_avg - ao.overall_avg as above_overall,
  ao.country_avg - ag.above_group_avg as above_group
FROM above_overall_cte ao
CROSS JOIN above_group_cte ag
WHERE ao.country_avg > ag.above_group_avg
ORDER BY ao.country_avg DESC;
